_: Presence-gated SCENE with a REPLAY POLICY (controls when/how often the banter re-fires). Same shape as scene-presence-banter.json, but autoStart adds replay controls — here `playOnce: true` so the argument plays AT MOST ONCE ever (the controller stops polling after the single play; no more looping). Other knobs (all AND-ed onto cooldownSeconds): `playHour`/`playHourTolerance` = only fire within a +/- window of an in-game hour (e.g. 12 = around noon); `gateGlobal` = a GLOB re-arm token — the scene plays only while the global == 0 and the controller SetValue(1)s it after, so it stays off until some OTHER event SetValue(0)s it (build the global in `globals[]` and reset it from a dialogue result / quest fragment / alias script). Test: coc RiverwoodSleepingGiantInn (save+reload on old save), stand near both → they argue ONCE; leave + return → silence (playOnce). Swap to playHour/gateGlobal to see the other policies. package bundles the recompiled MFSceneBanterController.pex automatically.
_globals: Build a GLOB here if you use gateGlobal; not needed for playOnce.

globals._: example re-arm token for the gateGlobal variant (unused by playOnce)

lines: You still owe me for the ale, Hilda.
Owe you? That swill wasn't worth a clipped septim.
Bah. Once is enough — I'll not waste breath on you again.
